title: Manyhands JSON v1 synchronization mutation data
description: The data of an item sync or repo sync envelope that stopped because its host is not trusted: the host it reached and the key that host presented, which is what a host approval is given. A synchronization reports no other data: what it published is in its effects, and every other result of one carries null.

algorithm.description: The algorithm of the key the host presented.

presented_fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the key the host presented: SHA256: and the digest of the public key.

expected_fingerprint.description: The fingerprint the host is pinned to, when the host presented another key than its pin. Null for a host that has no pin.
